## Changed
- Internal packaging metadata (`pack.mcmeta`) now declares the correct resource and data pack formats for Minecraft 26.2. The previous values were carried over from 26.1.x.

## Notes
- **Nothing changes for players** — this build behaves identically to v0.3.1. There are no new features, no fixes to how the mod plays, and no reason to hunt for a difference.
- The old values worked in practice, because Minecraft does not enforce pack formats for mod-bundled resources. This corrects them so the mod keeps working if that ever changes.
